fields.value: A product is included for a month only if it has a summed sales amount in both 2019 and 2020 (so the growth rate is computable); products lacking either year are excluded, with no zero-fill.

value.note: sales joined to times (year/month), customers->countries (France), channels, promotions, and currency (country+year+month).

value.expression: Growth base years 2019 and 2020; projected target year 2021, listed by calendar month

fields.value: sales.time_id -> times.time_id, using times.calendar_year and times.calendar_month_number
No zero-fill: a product-month is kept only if both its 2019 and 2020 sums exist; otherwise the projection is undefined and the row is dropped.

No fan-out: sales->times 1:1 (time_id), sales->channels 1:1 (channel_id), sales->promotions 1:1 (promo_id), sales->customers 1:1 (cust_id), customers->countries 1:1 (country_id), currency 1:1 on (country, year, month).

of.description: Projected 2021 sales per product and month = (((S2020 - S2019) / S2019) * S2020) + S2020, where S2019 and S2020 are the sums of sales.amount_sold for that product-month in 2019 and 2020, then multiplied by the 2021 currency conversion rate currency.to_us.

fields.value: one projected value per product per month; averaged across products within each month
number of products with a computable projection in that month; if zero, the month yields no row
